ideas.pitch: A Python and Streamlit dashboard that ingests raw logistics datasets, runs Isolation Forest for anomaly detection on delivery delays, and uses SHAP values to explain root causes of supply chain failures.
ideas.title: Supply Chain Bottleneck & Anomaly Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the core evaluation criteria of quantitative statistical analysis and actionable recommendations, heavily inspired by winning healthcare and log analysis pipelines.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent data wrangling utility that ingests messy CSV uploads, flags missing value distributions, detects outlier skews, and automatically applies imputation strategies while generating a visual quality report.
ideas.title: Automated Data Cleaning & Quality Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges in data-analytics-focused hackathons appreciate tools that streamline the mandatory cleaning and transformation phase while maintaining high interpretability.

ideas.pitch: An end-to-end exploratory data analysis application that processes transaction logs, executes RFM segmentation and K-Means clustering, and outputs actionable marketing recommendations for customer retention.
ideas.title: Retail Customer Segmentation & Cohort Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a classic business problem with clear, interpretable visualizations and direct commercial recommendations that non-technical judges can immediately evaluate.

ideas.pitch: A predictive analytics tool built for financial datasets that trains an XGBoost classifier to score transaction risk in real time, featuring an interactive feature-importance explorer for compliance officers.
ideas.title: Financial Fraud & Risk Scoring Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines robust quantitative modeling with a polished interactive dashboard, mirroring the winning pattern of explainable ML systems.

ideas.pitch: A geospatial and temporal analytics web app that processes city sensor data or ride-sharing logs to uncover rush-hour bottlenecks and visualize traffic density heatmaps across time horizons.
ideas.title: Urban Traffic Congestion & Pattern Miner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages geospatial visualization which consistently stands out during live presentations for turning raw rows of time-series data into compelling visual stories.
